name: God Helmet (Shiva): chirp both sides, then hippocampus right, 40 min
summary: Murphy's Shiva God Helmet variant: the modulated-40 Hz chirp steps around both temporal lobes, then a hippocampal theta-burst ('LTP') signal steps around the right side only. Murphy reports inner silence, deep calm, inner images and possibly a sense of spaciousness; independent double-blind tests found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012).
notes: Phase 1 (20 min): the chirp on all eight coils, left side clockwise and right side counter-clockwise. Phase 2 (20 min, abrupt switch): the hippocampal signal on the four right coils only, counter-clockwise. The vendor page gives no phase lengths; the usual God Helmet 20 + 20 or 30 + 30 min are used. If anxiety or fear appears during or after phase 2, don't reuse the session (Murphy explains it as 'spill' from the right hippocampus into the right amygdala); Murphy says not to begin with this session if you are prone to anxiety; the vendor calls it experimental. If headaches occur (the vendor reports about 2% with hippocampal signals), lower the intensity by one-third. Not for anyone with a psychiatric diagnosis or medication, epilepsy, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs; no other mind machines at the same time; stop on any distress. Field about 1 µT, as in the lab God Helmet. The 'modulated 40 Hz chirp' template is proprietary. Murphy relates it to the frequency-modulated Thomas pattern, so it is approximated by a decelerating sweep from 40 to 6 Hz (the range is a choice) in 3-ms points, 2.5 s on and 1.5 s off: the 837 points of Dixon & Persinger 2001 (who used 1-ms points) at the 3-ms points of Tiller & Persinger 2002, once every 4 s; the 40 Hz modulation itself is not reproduced. The hippocampal 'LTP' template is unpublished; it is approximated by the project's Larson & Lynch theta-burst table (4 pulses at 100 Hz per burst) at the 5.4 Hz spectral peak the vendor reports for this signal, 4 bursts (0.6 s) then the vendor's standard 4 s silence, so the trains fill about 8 s of each minute (the vendor states about 9.6 s of field per minute). The burst count is a choice; the vendor's 3-ms points are not copied because the 100 Hz pulses need 0.5-ms points. Coil steps: the exact step time is unpublished (Murphy: one cycle takes 'a fraction of a second'), so 125 ms per coil (0.5 s per cycle) is used. Directions follow Murphy's 'clockwise over the left side, counter-clockwise over the right', read with each side seen from its own side, so both sides step top, back, bottom, front (C5-TP7-T9-FT7 and C6-TP8-T10-FT8); this reading is an inference (an image caption on Murphy's session list says the right side cycles clockwise, contradicting his text; the text is followed), and the placement order is set so the app's per-side directions mean exactly this. The cross centred near T7/T8 is an inference from 'four coils over each temporal lobe, above and forward of the ears'. This is the 40-min version (20 + 20 min); the 60-min version is murphy-gh-chirpbi-hippr-60min.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence; relax without meditating or falling asleep.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 6, then a 21-day break; do not mix with other Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks (Murphy).
